scenario: [LNUL.4.9] a CONSTANT subject tests tag AND value, where a tag name tests the tag alone. Drives the eval arm with subject IS_SUBJECT_TRUE over a Bool slot holding false, un-negated. The rule does NOT fire: the tag matches Bool but the value is not the one the constant names. Contrast LNUL.4.9c, where the tag-name subject fires on any Float including inf. An implementation that folded the six constants into their tag — answering `is true` for every Bool — would fire here. fact_count 1.
rules_ds:
schema Flag scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    is_on: Bool? mutable

schema Marker scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule r:
    Flag f where f.is_on is true
->
    emit Marker logical entity_id: f.entity_id
